title: Checking a replacement reception phone
titleZh: 驗收新換的接待處電話
passage: Hi, it’s Nia from Facilities. I left the replacement phone at reception. It can already call out. Making a call doesn’t show that the phone can receive one. Please use your own mobile to call the reception number printed on our front door. The number on the sticker under the new phone is just for the installer. If the new phone rings, put the old one in its box. If only the old one rings, leave it plugged in and call me. The staff directory will stay as it is. We’re changing the phone, not the number people use to reach us.
passageZh: 嗨，我是總務的妮亞。我把替換用的電話放在接待處。它已經能打出去。但能撥出電話，不代表這支電話能接到來電。 請用自己的手機撥打貼在大門上的接待處電話。新電話底下貼紙上的號碼只供安裝人員使用。如果新電話響了，把舊電話放回盒裡。如果只有舊電話響，讓它繼續接著，再打電話給我。 員工通訊錄維持原樣。我們換的是電話，不是大家打來找我們用的號碼。
